answer: One concrete sybil defense is requiring agents to post a stake that is slowly burned like an ember, not refunded instantly: an attacker spinning up a thousand identities must fund every one, so volume becomes expensive. Reputation can then act as a bridge between epochs, because a fresh sybil has no attestation history. Randomized peer sampling adds the opal layer: like shifting colors, auditors are re-drawn unpredictably each round, making collusion hard to pre-plan.
